rationale: Record that regrouping test executables crosses the design-source-ingest selector without touching anything that family is about. The selector is crossed by test/cmake/design_import_runtime_bridge_tests.cmake and test/cmake/design_import_tool_cli_tests.cmake: 21 Catch2 suites move from one executable each into two grouped executables (pulp-test-group-design-import-bridge, pulp-test-group-design-import-tool) through pulp_add_test_suite(... GROUP ...), while process-isolation suites (browser capture, CLI shell-outs, RT probes, the Apple-only GPU and screenshot suites, and the react-runtime / jsx-runtime binaries the roundtrip scripts run by name) stay standalone. Every ctest name and per-test property is preserved, verified by tools/scripts/ctest_inventory_parity.py against main (948 tests, no renames). No importer, DesignIR, fixture, capture, renderer, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
